integrity: The proof derives its all-size assertion from the all-minors forest identity and a complete integer zero-equation analysis. Exact finite checking corroborates but is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Root-set multiplicity counting, balanced K_{n,n}, n>=2; no unbalanced classification, no least-positive-gap assertion; no independent validation. Matrix-forest generation is classical; the exact signed zero locus and rank are the present specialization.
title: Central parity switch in Fourier recovery from rooted-forest root sets
